name: Kamakura AMBROSIA
source:
The game takes place in junior high and follows the story of Izumi and Sakura's meeting and departure. Would you try to understand him or would you reject him? Can you let go of the memories of you and your childhood friend?

[Edited from [url=https://yukireinomoney.itch.io/kamakura-ambrosia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
游戏发生在初中时期，讲述了泉和小樱的相遇和离开的故事。你会尝试去理解他还是会拒绝他？你能放下你和你儿时好友的回忆吗？

[编辑自[url=https://yukireinomoney.itch.io/kamakura-ambrosia]itch.io[/url]]
